userStories.title: Wire memory.user.write capability check at WriteApprovedUserFact entry
userStories.description: Add the Authorize() boundary call before writing a user_memory row. (a) Modify `internal/learning/user_memory_writer.go` (or wherever US-O03 placed WriteApprovedUserFact) to accept an additional parameter `actor identity.Actor` and a `authz identity.Authorizer` interface (small abstraction: `Authorize(ctx, actor, capability, resource) (Decision, error)`). (b) At the start of WriteApprovedUserFact, call `authz.Authorize(ctx, actor, identity.CapabilityMemoryUserWrite, identity.ResourceRef{Type:'user_memory', ID:proposal.Handle})`. If Decision != DecisionAllow, return `identity.ErrPermissionDenied` (a new sentinel error exported from internal/identity OR re-use existing one — locate via grep). Log the denial via slog.Warn with actor_id + capability + reason (NOT raw args — privacy invariant). (c) Caller chain update: the applier path that invokes WriteApprovedUserFact must thread the actor from the proposal owner (proposal.ActorID typically lives in the proposed_updates row). If the row lacks an actor_id column, add migration v16 to extend proposed_updates with actor_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '' (back-compat empty = system actor with full grant). (d) NO change to the existing WriteApprovedLesson (operational_memory) path — that's a Phase 6 scope and operates under system actor by design. (e) Tests in `internal/learning/user_memory_writer_test.go`: 4 new cases — owner actor with CapabilityMemoryUserWrite: write succeeds; dashboard token actor WITHOUT grant: returns ErrPermissionDenied + no write; nil actor (system call): allowed back-compat; missing capability check via a fake Authorizer returning DecisionDeny: deny+no-write.

userStories.title: Add ambiguity question gate before creating user_memory proposal
userStories.description: When summarizer triage decides user_memory but the Candidate is ambiguous (Score < threshold), instead of silently creating a proposed_updates row, emit an ask_user question via the Phase 1C QuestionGate infrastructure. The operator's reply approves/rejects the routing. (a) New file `internal/conversation/summarizer/question_gate.go` with: const `AmbiguityThreshold = 0.7` (subject to constant tweaking — comment that 0.7 was chosen as the empirical break point between LLM-confident and edge cases). Function `ShouldGateUserMemoryWrite(c Candidate) bool` returns true when `c.Category` triages to TargetUserMemory AND `c.Score < AmbiguityThreshold`. (b) Modify the createUserMemoryProposal flow from US-O02: if ShouldGateUserMemoryWrite returns true, instead of writing the proposed_updates row directly, emit a QuestionEvent via the hub (chat.EventQuestionRequested) with question='Vuoi che ricordi: %s? (categoria: %s, score: %.2f)' + options=['Sì, ricordalo','No, scarta','Sì ma con modifica']. Persist a row in chat_questions (Phase 1C table) with payload carrying the pending Candidate JSON. (c) On reply (Hub.RecordQuestionAnswer wired in commit 1584a8fa already calls back): if answer is 'Sì, ricordalo', proceed with createUserMemoryProposal verbatim. If 'No, scarta', no-op + log skipped. If 'Sì ma con modifica' or free-text answer with a non-trivial edit, replace Candidate.Fact with the user's text and proceed. (d) NO change to the wiki path or operational_memory path — gate is user_memory only. (e) Tests in `internal/conversation/summarizer/question_gate_test.go` and integration in `internal/learning/triage_routing_test.go`: 5 cases — Score≥0.7 routes direct (no gate); Score<0.7 emits chat_questions row + does NOT create proposed_updates; reply 'Sì, ricordalo' creates the proposal; reply 'No, scarta' skips; reply with free-text modification replaces Fact then creates proposal.

userStories.title: Integration test: Authorize gate + question gate end-to-end
userStories.description: Lock the full end-to-end flow with one integration test that exercises both Q01 and Q02 gates. (a) New file `internal/learning/write_guards_integration_test.go`. (b) Test scenario 'TestUserMemoryWriteGuardsEndToEnd': 1) seed identity store with 2 actors — owner (has CapabilityMemoryUserWrite) + dashboard_session (does NOT have it); 2) seed summarizer with 3 candidates — high-score preference (Score=0.9), low-score preference (Score=0.5), high-score project (Score=0.9, routes to wiki); 3) run applier with actor=owner; 4) assert: high-score preference creates proposed_updates kind='user_memory' DIRECTLY (no question); low-score preference creates chat_questions row + NO proposed_updates yet; project candidate creates a wiki proposal (existing path); 5) simulate user reply 'Sì, ricordalo' to the chat_questions row → triggers proposed_updates kind='user_memory' creation; 6) simulate approval of that proposed_updates row → calls WriteApprovedUserFact with actor=owner → succeeds + creates compact_memory_documents kind='user_memory'; 7) repeat the approval flow with actor=dashboard_session → returns ErrPermissionDenied + no compact_memory_documents row; 8) verify slog.Warn entries for the denial. (c) Test scenario 'TestUserMemoryQuestionGateRejection': low-score candidate, user replies 'No, scarta' → asserts no proposed_updates row, no compact_memory_documents row, audit log shows rejection. (d) Use existing test helpers from internal/identity/auth (for actor fixtures) and internal/db/migrations (for in-memory DB).
